verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a CLI for running tests/collections and an official MCP server that lets an agent read and modify collections, requests, environments, and teams, giving substantial programmatic parity with UI actions. However, there is no documented public REST/GraphQL API (OpenAPI probe returned 404s across all endpoints), so many UI-only features (workspace management, sharing, embed, SSO/admin config) have no confirmed API equivalent. Missing for 10: a full first-party REST/GraphQL API spec covering all UI functionality, and independent confirmation that MCP/CLI cover collaboration, sharing, and admin features.
